profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with over a decade of experience working primarily in C++ and C# and debugging for Xbox and Windows. Familiar with a wide range of languages and technologies from assisting dozens of game development teams; adapting to their codebases, tools, and processes to work hands-on in unfamiliar code and debug issues. Always ready to take on new problems, and just like when performance profiling, form an understanding and find where changes will have impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed an Unreal plugin to interface our C++ services dll as an OnlineSubsystem. Created automated tests using Unreal’s test framework to validate API and service behavior. Maintained plugin support across UE4 and UE5 versions for multiple teams.
•  Assisted four game teams integrating our plugin; led integration meetings, wrote documentation, created tools for iteration, and implemented feedback and requests.
•  Instrumented and profiled the Unreal plugin and service dll using Unreal Insights and Xperf. Identified and fixed perf gaps and ensured our APIs met game teams’ standards.
•  Designed and developed portions of a C++ services library that used gRPC to send Protobuf messages to our service backend. Built to support Win, Linux, Xbox and PS5.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Xbox Advanced Technology Group
positions.description:
Game Performance Profiling - Gathered and analyzed CPU performance traces for Xbox games with Xperf and PIX. Identified inefficient code, expensive or zombied assets, thread stalls, memory leaks, lock chains, bottlenecks, asset loading bugs, and other performance issues. Then authored reports to summarize issues, offer solutions, and suggest optimizations for Xbox.

Machine Learning Incubation - Developed an artifact reduction CNN for denoising key subregions of compressed video frames in realtime. Used Keras (Tensorflow backend) for development and training with DirectML for realtime GPU evaluation. Filed patent:
Kennett, Daniel. Walston, Eric. Gordon, Matthew. 2019. Selectively Enhancing Compressed Digital Content. U.S. Patent 11,032,576, filed Jun 10, 2019. Published Sep 2, 2021

Continued ownership of previous responsibilities on this team

positions.title: Software Engineer 2 - Xbox Advanced Technology Group
positions.description:
•  Collaborated with game development partners both on-site and remotely to help them debug their Xbox platform integration issues and follow best practices.
•  Presented at XFest and GDC on Xbox process lifetime debugging and UWP API features.
•  Improved third party engine and tools partners’ usage of Xbox platform APIs.
•  Wrote public and developer documentation with samples for Xbox and UWP games.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2 - HEMI Team
positions.description:
•  Assisted first and third party game developers with debugging Xbox integration issues.
•  Wrote and reviewed developer documentation for Xbox app activation and process lifetime.
•  Improved Xbox platform integration support for Unreal and Unity.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test 2 - Xbox Application Platform Team
positions.description: Continued ownership of previous responsibilities on this team with a greater expectation of code quality, development speed, and reduced oversight.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test - Xbox Application Platform Team
positions.description:
Writing automated build validation tests and regression tests for platform features
Debugging Xbox console application platform features like activation and process lifetime management
Testing Xbox build quality and signing off on platform feature quality for releases

positions.title: Senior Assistant for the Computer Science Department
positions.description: Hold office hours, run weekly labs, and grade homework and tests for undergraduate Computer Science courses.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Assist students with homework, test preparation, and studying for eight computer science courses including Operating Systems and Software Engineering.

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description: Taught iPhone App development, Beginner Programming, and Unreal Engine 3 modding to classes of up to eight campers. Assisted the director in managing daily camp activities and supervising seven instructors.

positions.title: Curriculum Reviewer
positions.description: Worked with a developer to  redesign, update, and modify the current curriculum. Technical writing designed to be understood by children.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught Beginner Programming and Unreal Engine 3 modding to classes of up to nine campers.
